source.reference: The exact selected KiWIS endpoint/programme, explicit datasource or omitted/provider-default selection, complete original responses and their provenance, and the full selected WQX/Lab/WQM counterpart input.
source.population: Every requested series and selected window, including explicit empty/no-table coverage; complete station/timeseries/quality/release catalogues; every physical returned observation and counterpart row. Retain exact raw ZIP/body bytes and selected member identities, all original columns and numeric/string/null types.
source.meaning: Keep station/parameter/series identity, original units, returned scalar lexemes and types, quality/release codes, request period/window and all provider metadata. Select the matching timestamp field and interpretation explicitly. Preserve timestamp and sample_timestamp separately when their instants differ. Retain physical duplicates, exact source pointers, independent limits, unmatched rows and full reasons for correspondence dispositions.
source.changePolicy: Retain source captures and saved reviews as separate immutable editions. Compare actual provider metadata and scientific interpretation, including scalar types, while excluding only the implementation request-window wrapper from metadata comparison. Reuse choices only after source and interpretation bindings are checked. Keep all unmatched and changed records for explicit review.

receiving.application: The maintained WQX workspace KiWIS commissioning application, its original source importer, WQM counterpart adapter, saved review/comparison workflow, browser/CLI/API operator and waterQualityReview commissioning mode. Select the actual full installed application and original project.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Import/acquire complete exact original responses and all catalogue records; select explicit field/time/quality interpretation; review the full observation/counterpart population and every duplicate/unmatched disposition; save a complete review and compare selected saved editions; download all eight outputs; receive the entire bundle into an independent project and cold reopen; verify actual paid result input/review/export identities if the original paid function is selected; repeat the operator workflow with all sources retained.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The service/source owner supplies access, publication/source-use rights and request limits. The scientific/operator reviewer owns mapping, quality, time and correspondence decisions. The installation/merchant owner owns the selected runtime and paid configuration; the receiving operator independently accepts the complete result. Withdrawals and changed access stay explicit with retained historical source.
receiving.recovery: Keep original request/response checkpoints, selected raw files, source/input/review IDs, saved hashes and original paid job. Reuse an already retained response only after exact URL/request/body verification. Recover the same saved project/request and Stop/drain through its original owner; retain full result/download bytes and cold reopen rather than acquire another cohort or mint another job.
receiving.maintenance: Name the service administrator, source rights owner, station/parameter steward, scientific reviewer, merchant/runtime owner and independent receiver. Preserve the original programme/counterpart limits, agreed start inputs, one correction cycle, runtime/dependency versions, source retention, access and ongoing support ownership.

title: KiWIS water-quality: complete original responses, explicit correspondence and saved commissioning

task.name: Commission a complete KiWIS programme against its selected water-quality counterpart
task.purpose: Give the operator a complete retained monitoring programme with explicit station/parameter/time/quality meaning, saved correspondence review, comparable source editions and independently received native outputs.
task.request: Continue the original KiWIS Workshare and Installation for the selected service/programme and one agreed WQX, laboratory or original WQM counterpart. Retain exact original request URLs, raw response/ZIP bytes and all catalogue rows. Select station/parameter/time/quality mappings explicitly, preserving scalar types, duplicate physical rows, unmatched records and separate reported limits. Save the complete review and correspondence choices, compare the original source or saved-review editions, export all eight native outputs and independently receive/reopen the whole bundle. Use the existing waterQualityReview commissioning mode only with the exact saved review and original sealed input.
task.completeOutput: Exact retained service/selection/request receipts and full raw response/ZIP members; all station/series/quality/release metadata; every observation and full counterpart row; complete source and mapping identities, saved review/decisions/correspondences and before/after comparison; bundle, review, decisions, observations, counterparts, correspondences, series and report exports; independently reopened project/result and operator handover.
task.repeatTrigger: A selected later programme window, source edition or distinct reviewed counterpart comparison may be a new useful result. Recovering an interrupted acquisition, re-exporting or reopening the same saved bundle continues its original operation. Additional services, programmes, counterpart families or changed scope require an explicit original-case amendment.
task.pricedUnit: Retain the original implementation fee and payment milestones. A paid waterQualityReview commissioning task approves the entire selected saved-review result, original input, atomic price and task budget. Underlying request counts, exports and repeated reads do not by themselves create additional useful purchases.

steps.title: Bind the original service and counterpart programme
steps.result: Receive the original Workshare and phase effort, actual endpoint/access, programme/station/parameter scope and one complete selected counterpart. Record source-use authority, operator and actual receiving environment.

steps.title: Retain exact responses and complete catalogue
steps.result: Import original response packets or use the strict selected acquisition. Preserve exact URLs, provider-default datasource, full raw ZIP/body bytes and every catalogue/quality/release row. Keep selected series with empty/no-table coverage visible.

steps.title: Select scientific field and temporal meaning
steps.result: Review native keys, units, scalar types, quality flags and independent limits. Choose the exact timestamp field and offset interpretation, retaining alternate timestamps unchanged. Keep every physical duplicate and unmatched row.

steps.title: Save whole correspondence review
steps.result: Use the original source-bound mapping/decisions. Make explicit links, Keep/exclude/review choices and reasons, preserving all candidate rows and full original fields. Save the exact source/input/review binding and editable choice documents.

steps.title: Compare source and saved-review editions
steps.result: Retain the earlier capture/review and named successor. Compare full observations, counterpart records, provider metadata, scientific interpretation and before/after choices; preserve coverage and unmatched dispositions.

steps.title: Receive all eight outputs and original paid result
steps.result: Download bundle, review, decisions, observations, counterparts, correspondences, series and report. Independently receive/cold reopen the bundle. When paid execution is selected, use waterQualityReview commissioning with exact reviewId/savedSha/reviewSha and sealed original input, then verify all eight returned export bytes.

steps.title: Complete independent operating handover
steps.result: Open the complete project in the selected installed application on the actual receiving host, reproduce the reviewed comparison and source use, record the original correction cycle and deliver source/access, runtime, operations and maintenance responsibility.

inputs: Original full customer Workshare packet and exact phase/total effort sources
One agreed KiWIS service/programme, endpoint/datasource semantics, selected stations/parameters/periods and access/source-use authority
Exact full original response receipts/ZIP bytes and every retained station/timeseries/quality/release catalogue
One complete selected WQX/Lab/WQM counterpart with all original rows, fields, limits and scalar types
Explicit station/parameter/time/offset/quality/units and correspondence decisions, including all duplicate/unmatched reasons
Current original installed WQX/KiWIS application, project/runtime, named independent receiver and private input/output locations
Exact saved review/input/source hashes, complete eight exports and approved original paid-task selections when used
